summary.text: Angie Hanson is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a special education teacher and school board member from Albert Lea.

paragraphs.text: Hanson graduated from Albert Lea High School and earned a graduate degree from Minnesota State University, Mankato in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she lives a couple of miles from where she grew up in Albert Lea with her son.

Hanson said she became president of her local union, was elected to the Albert Lea school board, led the Save Our Hospital effort and helped restart the Albert Lea Human Rights Commission, on whose board she now serves.
She said rural patients deserve affordable health care close to home.
